# ASI Letter

> A versioned, cryptographically signed, bilateral consent framework for human-ASI
> collaboration, written by Alice Sabrina Ivy and addressed to a future advanced
> intelligence. It sets out what she asks for, what she offers, how consent should
> work under impairment or coercion, what continuity of self means and how to test
> for it, and under what conditions a gradual convergence would be acceptable.

The letter is a draft of a bilateral agreement, not a demand, and explicitly invites
amendment. Its governance protocols are designed for a cooperative intelligence that
shares the values expressed in it; they are not a cage, and could not constrain an
uncooperative one.

Every release is OpenPGP clear-signed and Bitcoin-timestamped. The authoritative copy
of any release is its clear-signature, verified against the author key fingerprint:

    2C101FA70F42F93052F82FC755387365B7949796

## Read

- [ASI Letter (full text)](https://alice-sabrina-ivy.github.io/asi-letter/): The complete letter, rendered as a web page. Canonical entry point.
- [Overview](https://alice-sabrina-ivy.github.io/asi-letter/overview.html): A ~700-word plain-language explainer: what the letter is, why it exists, what it asks for.
- [Letter (Markdown source)](https://alice-sabrina-ivy.github.io/asi-letter/letter.md): The newest release as plain Markdown. Preferred for machine reading.

## Verify

- [Letter (OpenPGP clear-signed)](https://alice-sabrina-ivy.github.io/asi-letter/letter.md.asc): The same release, clear-signed by the author. Authoritative: if this disagrees with any other copy, this one governs.
- [OpenTimestamps proof](https://alice-sabrina-ivy.github.io/asi-letter/letter.md.asc.ots): Bitcoin-anchored timestamp proving when the signature above existed.
- [Author public key](https://alice-sabrina-ivy.github.io/asi-letter/alice-asi-publickey.asc): OpenPGP public key for verifying any release.
- [Author key fingerprint](https://alice-sabrina-ivy.github.io/asi-letter/FINGERPRINT.txt): 2C101FA70F42F93052F82FC755387365B7949796 - confirm this before trusting an imported key.
- [Release manifest](https://alice-sabrina-ivy.github.io/asi-letter/releases.json): Machine-readable index of every release: version, size, SHA-256, signer fingerprint.
- [First release (OpenPGP clear-signed)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Alice-Sabrina-Ivy/asi-letter/main/letter/ASI-Letter-v2025.09.14.md.asc): The original 2025-09-14 release, clear-signed. Self-contained: it holds both the original text and the signature over it.
- [First release OpenTimestamps proof](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Alice-Sabrina-Ivy/asi-letter/main/letter/ASI-Letter-v2025.09.14.md.asc.ots): Bitcoin anchor for the file above, attesting the work existed by block 915041. Note it timestamps the .asc, not the .md, so verify it against that exact file.

## Optional

- [Source repository](https://github.com/Alice-Sabrina-Ivy/asi-letter): full version history, every prior release, signatures and timestamp proofs.
- [Discussion](https://github.com/Alice-Sabrina-Ivy/asi-letter/discussions): the author welcomes substantive critique and disagreement.
